summary:
We developed a web game using Python, pygame and Flask. In Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer, players run a research outpost on Mars for 30 sols (Martian days). Each day they pick one of three jobs to keep oxygen, water, food and electricity from running out, while surviving dust storms and solar radiation events. The radiation events are based on nine real X-class solar flares from NASA’s DONKI archive, so stronger flares cause more damage. After every choice, the game shows a sourced fact from NASA missions such as Perseverance, Curiosity, Ingenuity and the ISS, plus astronaut health facts from NASA’s Open Science Data Repository. The game runs on my computer and streams to any web browser, so players need to install nothing.

It turns real NASA science into a fun, hands-on way for young learners to understand the challenges of living on Mars. Games like this build curiosity, resource-management thinking and interest in space careers.

The main challenge we faced is stream the pygame screen to a website. It is important because any systems with different OS can be run this game through the website except creating .exe or .apk file.
details:
Our project is an interactive space exploration game developed using Python, Pygame, and Flask. Pygame is used to create the game, including its graphics, animations, sounds, and gameplay. Flask is used to stream the Pygame game to a locally hosted website, allowing users to play through a web browser. Another special feature is that the game can be accessed and played from any device connected to the same network as the laptop running the program.

We believe this game will help children learn about space missions, space exploration, and the challenges astronauts face in space. It combines education with entertainment, making learning more interesting and interactive. Our main goal is to increase children's interest in space science while improving their problem-solving and decision-making skills.

We used Python, Pygame, Flask, and HTML to develop the project. The main creative aspect is making a Python-based game playable through a website without installing it on other devices. During development, our team considered accessibility, user-friendly controls, attractive graphics, smooth gameplay, and educational value.
